dog.description_text:
Who could go for a Guinness? This 2.5-year-old, 33 pound Frenchie is as cute as they come. Guinness is the total package...with expressive eyebrows, a truly adorable underbite and tongue that tends to stick out just a little, she turns heads everywhere! This compact cutie walks well on a leash, is great in her crate and loves to play with a stuffed toy. Guinness has done well so far when passing fellow pups on the street and loves cuddly companionship. Guinness is getting used to the good life and will thrive with a confident adopter who can continue to help her feel safe and establish strong commuication skills together.

Approved adopters interested in Guinness can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not approved yet, apply today at hbrdogs.com.
